authors: S. A. Saakyan, V. A. Sautenkov, B. B. Zelener
title: Energy intervals between Rydberg states nD and nF in lithium-7
method: MOT fluorescence-loss spectroscopy, cw UV from 2p 2P3/2; residual-field-induced 2P-nF lines
conversion: Rows without uncertainty: 6 MHz, the differences to the nF - nD intervals implied by zelener2016 and sautenkov2016 (the stated 'better than 0.5 MHz' is doubtful, metadata caveats).
No J in the source from l = 2 on (fine structure unresolved): j = l + 1/2 assumed (the fine structure of these levels is far below the uncertainties).
caveats: the 0.5 MHz accuracy claim is doubtful given ~100 MHz linewidths and the 6 MHz differences to the nF-nD differences implied by zelener2016 Table 3 minus sautenkov2016 Table 1 (e.g. n=38: 191 MHz vs 175.2 MHz)
both levels Stark-mixed by residual field (nF observable only through mixing)
